chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: If you enter the privy and relieve yourself, then do not pour water, then perform wudu (ablution) and forget to do istinjāʾ, and you remember after you have prayed, then you must repeat. But if you had poured water and forgot to wash your penis until you prayed, then you must repeat the wudu (ablution) and the salat (prayer), and wash your penis, because urine is like feces.

key_terms.الْإِعَادَةُ: repetition of the act, here the salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْغَائِطَ: the privy or place of relieving oneself
key_terms.تَسْتَنْجِيَ: to cleanse the private area after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets istinjāʾ or washing after urination and then performs salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on neglecting purification after relieving oneself before performing salat (prayer). It distinguishes between failing to use water for cleansing and forgetting to wash the penis after urination, and it rules that the affected salat (prayer) must be repeated, with wudu (ablution) also repeated in the latter case.
